Film4.uk.title: The Pillow Book

Film4.uk.description: (1957) Offbeat melodrama starring Richard Burton (as an RAF officer), Joan Collins (as a nun), Basil Sydney and Cy Grant, who end up on a life raft together after their ship is torpedoed.

Film4.uk.title: The 300 Spartans
Film4.uk.description: (1962) Historical drama with Ralph Richardson. A retelling of the stand made at Thermopylae in 480 BC by a small Greek force against invasion by an enormous Persian army.

Film4.uk.title: Destroyer
Film4.uk.description: (1943) Second World War drama about a warship assigned to mail runs but that ends up engaged in battle anyway, starring Edward G Robinson, Glenn Ford and Marguerite Chapman.

Film4.uk.title: The Old Man and the Gun
Film4.uk.description: (2018) Fact-based crime biopic starring Robert Redford and Sissy Spacek. Charming 74-year-old bank robber Forrest Tucker falls for an enchanting farmer. But is he ready to retire?

Film4.uk.title: Flight of the Phoenix
Film4.uk.description: (2004) Drama. Dennis Quaid stars as the captain of an aircraft downed in the desert. There's no hope of rescue, unless he and the survivors can build another plane from the wreckage.

Film4.uk.title: Nobody
Film4.uk.description: (2021) Action thriller with Bob Odenkirk. He's just a dad who goes to work and takes out the trash. But really he's an ex-assassin about to unleash his true self... and take out the trash.

Film4.uk.title: Orphan: First Kill
Film4.uk.description: (2022) Horror prequel with Isabelle Fuhrman and Julia Stiles. Diminutive psychopath Esther - think Wednesday at a funeral - cons her way into a family to wreak murderous mayhem.

Film4.uk.title: The Second Act
Film4.uk.description: (2024) Quentin Dupieux's film-industry satire about a bunch of anxious actors stuck in a formulaic movie about relationship troubles, starring Louis Garrel, Raphaël Quenard and Léa Seydoux.
